title: Signature
desc: Five measured handwriting strokes are scheduled at distinct pen speeds with short lifts between them. A live nib follows the active path by arc length, making the signature feel written rather than revealed by one uniform CSS duration.
hint: The pen leaves a pressure-weighted stroke
sourceName: Seen on: founder notes, artist credits, luxury brand marks, and editorial sign-offs

prompt:
Use a native 300 by 320 composition. Remove ruled telemetry paper and make the ink signature a quiet signed document interaction. Use locally bundled Inter at weights 400–550 for UI and every numerical readout, with tabular numerals and normal tracking. Monospace is reserved for actual code or ASCII. Preserve pointer, keyboard, deterministic fixtures, reset behavior and lifecycle contracts. Build a self-contained variable-speed SVG signature writer with no dependencies. Use five distinct handwriting paths. Measure each path with getTotalLength(). Assign path-specific pen rates [210,128,274,165,318] SVG units per second, derive duration=length/speed*1000, and schedule strokes sequentially with a 90ms lift after each.

Maintain one elapsed timeline. For every stroke compute raw=(elapsed-start)/duration, clamp to 0..1, ease with 1-(1-progress)^2, and set dashoffset=length*(1-eased). For the active stroke, move a visible nib using getPointAtLength(length*eased). Because durations derive from different rates, strokes must visibly write at different speeds rather than sharing CSS duration.

Click, Enter/Space, or Replay restarts the complete schedule. Escape skips to the signed state. Pause offscreen with IntersectionObserver and continue from preserved elapsed time. Under prefers-reduced-motion, show the completed signature immediately. Synchronize stroke index, current rate, nib, completion, and live status. Include paper styling, visible focus, scoped CSS, and no dependencies.

V4: classes remain prefixed d-signature; full480x360 retains all original data and models. Native 260x152 follows Figma 161:692 and these exact asset/primitive slots: [{"selector":".d-signature-native-copy","x":100,"y":64,"w":200,"h":60,"text":"Ava Rhodes","font":48,"family":"Allura"},{"selector":".d-signature-native-rule","x":96,"y":138,"w":180,"h":1}]. All supplied SVG bytes and root dimensions remain unchanged; never extract or redraw their paths. Native uses exact locally bundled Allura48 Ava Rhodes above its180px rule. Pointer/pen/touch draws original pressure-aware line segments; Enter/Draw replays and Escape completes. Full retains five original handwriting paths, rates210/128/274/165/318 units per second, measured durations,90ms lifts, quadratic progress and an arc-length nib. Complete font and SIL OFL credits travel in single-file and separate CSS exports. Shared stage controls own actions; never add local chrome. Keep original numeric clocks, shared menu250ms entrance/150ms unstaggered exit/40ms entrance stagger, reduced motion, native pointer/keys/touch, caller/viewport/document holds, queued intent, abortable loading, complete cleanup and >=11px physical compact full text. No dependencies.
notes: Five measured handwriting strokes are scheduled at distinct pen speeds with short lifts between them. A live nib follows the active path by arc length, making the signature feel written rather than revealed by one uniform CSS duration.
Seen on: founder notes, artist credits, luxury brand marks, and editorial sign-offs
